sentence_stem: Since you did not send the payment,
correct_completion: we have to cancel your order.
full_sentence: Since you did not send the payment, we have to cancel your order.
acceptable_variants: we are unable to keep your order.

options.text: we will be happy to help you.
options.why_wrong: This is a polite offer. It does not follow as a result of the missing payment.

options.text: we have to cancel your order.

options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the payment was not sent.

options.text: the letter was written in English.
options.why_wrong: This describes the letter itself, not a result of the payment problem.

explanation: 'Since' introduces the reason, so the second clause must give the result of that reason. Portuguese speakers may choose a polite offer or an unrelated fact here, but the result must follow logically from the missing payment.
translation: Como você não enviou o pagamento, temos que cancelar seu pedido.
